verdict.rationale: Metorial's Magic Skills and sample bots (Slack standup, interview coordinator) imply repeatable, agent-driven workflows that could run without direct user prompting, and post-hoc trace/session review suggests some async operation, but there's no explicit documentation of a scheduler/trigger/cron mechanism for truly autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger infrastructure, independent confirmation that Skills run unattended in production, and detail on how 'autonomous' vs. user-invoked these workflows actually are.
